_source: Hand-written from what the Sunken Ship workbook and the Red Tide design doc state only in prose. Everything else in this folder is exported from RedTide_SunkenShip_data.xlsx by tools/export_redtide.py.
_flow_source: Blockout design notes: 'current runs bow -> stern inside the hull and along the Keel toward the breach, so blood made in the Salon reaches the Stern (and the Bull Shark) in about 40 s.' Bow is low x, the breach is at the Stern (x 58-68).

link_flow._note: Water moves through these passages bow to stern; blood crosses a link along the current faster than against it.

_alarm_source: Blockout design notes: 'Alarm region: Inside (Bridge..Stern) counts gunfire x2; Outside (Keel, Foredeck) x1.' Level mechanics: 'The ship is one region with two sub-regions (inside, outside).'
_outside_note: Species whose home zone is 'Outside' (the Tiger Shark) live in the open water around the wreck; the engine places them in the Keel & Sand zone's open water, at its far end.
_faction_source: Red Tide design doc, 'Enemy factions in detail: the Wreckers (template)' units table, squad tactics and barks.

units.tell: Bubbles from a fast exhale before a lunge
A red laser dot from the speargun's sight, 1 s before firing
Winds the cannon's winch for 2 s

spot: Divers on the wreck. Nobody's collecting our salvage.
chum: Let the reef do the work.
shark: That's not ours! Back to the breach!
Cut the chum, cut the chum!
net: Pull it in, pull it in.
foreman: The safe's mine, and so's the ship.
Winch up. Put a bolt through the helmet.

_diet_patch_source: Red Tide design doc, Level 1 beast table: 'Sergeant Major ... Eaten by: Grouper, moray'. The workbook's Diet matrix leaves both rows without it (--web-check flagged the Sergeant Major as uneaten). Patched weights are added, then each row is renormalised to sum to 1.
_flow_speed_note: Current speeds are set so blood made in the Salon reaches the Stern in about 40 s (the notes' own figure): about 1 m/s through the interior passages.
_confine_source: The user (2026-09-30): 'The doc intends that the player is confined to the ship entirely. They should not be going outside of the ship; it is meant to be claustrophobic/tight. If the Bridge doesn't have a means of making money then flush out where the fish are. Part of how a player can make scrip in this level is shooting out of the windows and holes of the yacht at fish.' The Keel and the Foredeck stay in the web (the sharks' lane, the schools) as open water seen and shot through portholes.

link_rules._note: divers: false = beasts and darts only. beasts: never | breach (closed to beasts until open_tide or until the Wreckers first come through it).

windows._note: Portholes generated wherever a room the divers use faces open water they don't, across a gap of at most gap_max_m.

_quest_source: The user (2026-09-30) asked for a short easter egg quest that leads to the Goliath fight. Written for the Sunken Ship: the chief engineer's log, his whistle, three blasts on the boiler's cord while the power is off.

quest.name: Supper Call
steps: An oil-stained log: 'She sleeps in the boiler's warmth. Three blasts on the whistle and she comes up for her supper. God help whoever's standing there.'
A brass steam whistle, green with age, hidden behind the pantry's tins.
The boiler's whistle cord. Fit the whistle and pull it three times.
quest.reward: Each diver's weapon is pressure-forged, and the Goliath's kill pays double.

_spawn_add_source: Fish for the start pocket and the water outside its windows (the user: 'flush out where the fish are'), so the first 250 scrip toward the Salon door can be earned inside the ship.

hidden_quest.log: The captain's log, in chalk over the ink: 'Three keys to the safe. The octopus took mine. The Foreman keeps his. The third is in the grouper, God keep us.'
hidden_quest._source: Hidden quests: the Sunken Ship: the captain's safe (read the log after tide 3; the Goliath's, the Foreman's and the octopus's keys; opening takes 20 s and rings the ship's bell (10 noise); 3,000 each and the Lightning Keel (the Galvanic Rod, Forged) for the opener; the dossier page 'The Owners'). The keys are the team's here, not carried: a downed diver doesn't drop one (our simplification).
